text:
Alice M: Heads up — planning a microstep canary for kv-cache-2.1 tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Need an owner for the deploy window (16:00–17:00). Plan is 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% with short holds. Who can own deploy + rollback?

Ben T: I can own deploy. I’ll be on standby from 15:30. Suggest starting 0.5% in low-traffic regions so we don't spike global routing.

Carla Q: QA will run the smoke harness. Smoke checklist:
1) gen latency p90 < 300ms
2) error-rate delta <= 0.5pp
3) KV hit-rate not dropping >2pp
I’ll post PASS/FAIL for each ramp step within ~5m.

Darren I: Infra note — autoscale is fine. Important: add a 5m hold after the 20% step for cache warming. Also set fallback route to kv-cache-2.0 for any 5xx spike.

Eve S: I’ll add a dashboard slice and alerts. Tagging: canary=kvcache-2.1-micro. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/kv-cache-canary (internal). Alert thresholds will be p95 +10% and error-rate +0.5pp.

Ben T: Plan + roles: Ben deploy, Carla smoke, Darren rollback infra, Eve monitoring. I’ll push the canary flag and start at 16:00 UTC. Rollback plan: flip routing flag back to 2.0 + revert canary tag.

Alice M: Ack. @channel if any conflicts with timing or owners please flag now.

deploy-bot: [pipeline queued] pipeline #3421 queued by Ben T — awaiting manual approval.

Ben T: approving now, starting canary.

deploy-bot: [deploy started] kv-cache-2.1 -> 0.5% (region: ap-south-1, us-west-2).

Carla Q: smoke @0.5%: latency and error-rate look normal so far :thumbsup:.

deploy-bot: ramp scheduled: 5% in 5m.

Carla Q: 5% smoke: p95 +10ms, kv hit-rate stable — PASS.

deploy-bot: ramping to 20%.

Eve S: small retry-rate uptick in eu-west-1 (~0.3pp) — watching dashboards.

Darren I: holding at 20% for +5m for cache warm as planned.

Carla Q: 20% smoke: FAIL — error-rate +1.2pp on reranker routes (subset). Investigating.

Ben T: initiating rollback now, flipping traffic back to kv-cache-2.0 and disabling canary flag.

deploy-bot: [rollback initiated] reverting routing and stopping kv-cache-2.1 rollout.

Carla Q: Post-rollback smoke: PASS — error-rate back to baseline and latencies normal.

Alice M: Thanks everyone. Immediate action: triage reranker + kv-cache-2.1 integration, add targeted perf tests for reranker paths. I’ll schedule a follow-up sync Monday to decide next attempt. :eyes:
